text:
emily.marketing: Hey runtime team — preparing the press deck + webinar narrative for next week. We need a very small, fast sanity run to validate the headline bench numbers (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1k-tokens) for the 13B and 70B model variants. Also need artifacts that map traces to inbound lead buckets (webinar signups vs. organic). Can you help with a quick checklist and an ETA? :rocket:

jordan.runtime: We can do a micro-sweep. Quick Qs: which model flavors (fp16 vs 4-bit) and do you want coldstart included? Coldstart changes p95 a lot.

emily.marketing: Thanks — prefer the variants we plan to cite: 13B-quant (4-bit) and 70B-fp16. Include coldstart and warmed runs separately. We only need a tiny cohort (100 requests) but please capture traces + request headers so we can route leads. Deadline is ~24h if possible.

sam.eng: I can spin up a 100-request sweep on staging pools. Will run: warmup=10, batch=auto, seq_len=512. ETA ~6 hours. Will produce: raw traces, latency histogram, token throughput, and a small sample payload set.

nina.marketing: For the lead routing piece — we need a stable header we can detect later in logs. Suggest adding `X-RT-Route: webinar-apr` on requests that come from marketing demo flows. Can runtime stamp that into traces?

jordan.runtime: Yep, we can set `X-RT-Route` header in the bench client and include it in the trace metadata. We'll also add `bench_run_id` on traces so you can join to CRM later. Example run command: 
```
./tools/run_bench --model 13B-4bit --requests 100 --warmup 10 --header "X-RT-Route:webinar-apr" --out-dir /tmp/bench-1812349000
```

sam.eng: queued the job. benchbot shows it as PENDING.

benchbot: Job queued: bench-1812349000 (owner: sam.eng). Estimated run time: 00:18:00.

sam.eng: first pass done for 13B-4bit. Quick numbers: p50=42ms, p95=210ms (warmed), coldstart p95=480ms. Throughput ~= 800 tokens/sec on a T4-equivalent pool. Uploading artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-dev/bench/1812349000/13b-4bit/

emily.marketing: awesome — can you include a small CSV mapping `bench_run_id` -> `X-RT-Route` and a sample of 10 traces with the headers visible? Marketing needs to hand those to analytics for lead scoring.

sam.eng: will attach CSV and sample traces. Also running 70B-fp16 now, will update when done.

jordan.runtime: For the press deck, note that cost-per-1k will be estimate-only (we use current instance prices + token rates). Sam — please include the command used to compute cost and the exact kernel/commit hash/runtime version. We need reproducibility.

sam.eng: got it. I'll add runtime: v2.3.1, commit: 8f7b2a, and the cost script invocation in the out-dir.

ella.sales: FYI sales — if you see `X-RT-Route:webinar-apr` hits after launch, route those leads into the webinar follow-up queue (segmentation: hot if response < 1 minute, warm otherwise). Can marketing confirm?

nina.marketing: confirmed. We'll map: webinar header + lead source=signup form => priority=hot. We'll share the final mapping file.

sam.eng: 70B-fp16 run finished. Quick numbers: warmed p50=120ms, p95=450ms, coldstart p95=980ms, throughput ~= 2200 tokens/sec. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-dev/bench/1812349000/70b-fp16/

sam.eng: attached files in S3: `metrics.json`, `latency_hist.csv`, `sample_traces.tar.gz`, `bench_run_map.csv`, `run_cmd.txt`. bench_run_map.csv has columns: bench_run_id, model, header_tag, run_time, commit.

emily.marketing: thank you!! Can you also run one tiny rerun with simulated live traffic (50% webinar header, 50% organic) to confirm routing header propagation under small concurrency? Just to show in webinar demo the routing works end-to-end.

jordan.runtime: Will do a 200-request mixed run with concurrency=4 and include trace join keys. Sam — can you schedule?

sam.eng: scheduled mixed run now. ETA ~30m.

benchbot: Job started: bench-1812349000-mixed (owner: sam.eng). ETA 00:25:00.

sam.eng: mixed run done. Verified `X-RT-Route` header present in 100% of traces where it was included, and bench_run_map.csv updated. No sampling loss at concurrency=4.

emily.marketing: perfect. Can you drop links to the S3 paths and a short one-paragraph summary of the numbers for the press deck (one line per model: p50/p95/cost estimate)? We'll convert to slide bullets. :pray:

sam.eng: S3 links above. Summary: 13B-4bit (warmed) p50=42ms p95=210ms cost≈$0.12/1k tokens; 70B-fp16 (warmed) p50=120ms p95=450ms cost≈$0.52/1k tokens. All runs include `bench_run_id` and `X-RT-Route:webinar-apr` header where requested.

jordan.runtime: Confirmed we attached runtime version and commit in each out-dir.

emily.marketing: amazing — this is exactly what we needed. I'll prepare the press slide and tag you for review. If any issues crop up in the next 24h, please ping here. :tada:

ella.sales: Ping me when the final CSV is in place, want to wire up the CRM mapping.

emily.marketing: will do. Thanks everyone!
